content: Omegan-ebogwad-gambasamalad
Bab-Jehová anga sogded:
“Dule-machi, omegan walabo nan-galagwenmalad gudii gusad.

Yagwaga-gunonimalad-akale, gambanuchu-imakdii gudmalad. Egipto-yargi abirgunagwarsuli galagwensur nanasmalad. Egipto-yalagine, niagwale e-mam-ebulesad na baisur-itosmalad. E-mam-gannarba-gannarbagwad e-ibe niagwale bele-bele imaksamalad. Bar yaganaga gunonisurmalad.
Bunagwa-sailaginedi, Aholaʼye nugad, e-urbadi, Aholibaʼye nugad. We-bunamala an nikusad. Anga mimmigan baksamalad. (Ahola, Samaria gued. Aholibaʼdi, Jerusalén gued.)
”Amba an Ahola-nikadgine, Ahola an-dikarba yoledii gusad. Surbinsa Asiria-dulemar-abedii gusad, ar amar, e-ai-nuedga gusad.
Asiria-dulemarde,
”Ahola gambanuchuyobi Asiria-dulemar bur nug-nikamaladga san-urmaksad. Na bela e-ai-nuedga-imakdii gusad, degine, bela Siria-dulemar-e-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklemaladba isgusad.

Egipto-yargi gambanuchu-imakdigusadi, Ahola gwen-indaksasulid. Yagwad-akale, bukidar macherganbo-megdii gusad. E-mam-gannarba-gannarbagwad e-ibe niagwale bele-bele imaksamalad. Aholaʼgine bela-bela nialesmalad.
”A-ulale, e-ai-nuedga-imakdiidga an urmaksad. Asiria-dulemarga an urmaksasunnad. Surbinsa amarbina sogdii gusad.
Asiria-dulemar Ahola-e-abgangi dodosmalad. Ahola-ibe machimala, degi, bunamala susmalad. Geb Aholaʼdi es-suidgi oburgwismalad. Bela omegan, Ahola e-isgusadba-sabsur-odurdaklesadi, wisgusmalad.
”E-urba-Aholiba, weyob e-ior-gusad na daksa gusanad, degi-inigwele, aka bur bule e-iorba na galagwensuli guded. E-iorba bur bule gambanuchu-imakdii gusad.
Aholiba surbinsa Asiria-dulemar-abedii gusmogad. Asiria-dulemarde,
”Aholiba isguedgi-gaamakdii an daknonikid. E-ior-Ahola-isgudigusadbali, na isgudii gusmogad.
”Degi-inigwele, Aholiba bur bule gambanuchu-saed baligannosad. Aholiba dakalid, galugi ibmar-wilubmar weyob sobar nanai:
”Aholiba a-ibmar-wilubmar-sobaled dakargua, nue-e-bina-sogsad. Geb Caldea-yarse gayaburba-berbemalad barmisad.
Geb Babilonia-dorgan ese nonimalad, Aholiba-ebo na galagwensuli gusmalad. Babilonia-dorgan Aholibaʼbo bukidar gambanuchu-imakdii gusad. Geb Aholiba wemar-ima dakalid. A-sorbali, egi aibacha gusad.
Aholiba na bingesuli dulemar-wagab gambanuchu-imakdii gusad, na san-urmakdii gusad. Geb degine, an igi iduar e-ior ima dakargusa, deyobi an Aholiba ima daknonimogad.
Degi-inigwele, Aholiba bur bule gambanuchu-imakdii guded. Egipto-yargi yagwaun gambanuchu-imakdigusad ebinsad gusad.
Ar surbinsa Egipto-dulemar-abedii gusad, ar amar, e-ai-nuedga gusad. Egipto-dulemarde, moli-uayasuidyob na e-abgan nikamaladid, moliyob abgan-burba mimaladid.

Deebali, Aholibaʼde, yagwaun galagwensuli-gudigusad gannar ebinsad gusad. Deunni, Egipto-dulemar niagwale e-mam-ebusadi na baisur-itosad. E-mam-gannarba-gannarbagwad e-ibe niagwale bele-bele imaksamalad. Bar yagwaga gunonisurgusad.
”Aholiba, a-ulale, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: ‘Emide, be-aimar-nuedga-be-imakdigusad-imadakedi, begi-aibinega an imakoed. Emide, bela dulemar-napneggi-bukmalad an begi barmidagoed:

” ’Asiria-dulemar danimarmogoed, bela wemar, sapingan-yeerdaklemaladid, dummagan-negdakmamaidid, sordamar-e-dummaganad, sorda-bila-onomaladid, degi, dule-nuga-nikamaladid, bela wemar moli-birgi-sii nanamaladid. Bela we-dulemar an begi barmidagoed.

Bukidar begi ur-napaginmalad-bila-onomaladgi danimaloed. E-sorda-bila-onomaladi, bormo-gurgin-sii-sii, degi, sigu-abgaed-gani-gani begi danimaloed. We-dulemar bega igar-nabomalaga an imakoed. E-igar-mamaidba bega igar nabomaloed.

An-urwed be itogoed, wemar sabsur-be-imakmaloed. Be-ibe asu sikmaloed, uaya sikmarbaloed. Dulemar-a-ibagi-oburgwilegosurmaladdi, es-suidgi oburgwilemaloed. Deginbali, we-dulemar be-annik be-machimala sumaloed, be-bunamala sumarbaloed. Dulemar-oburgwilegosurmalad-baigandi soogi ogumaklegoed.
Mor be-ibe ungemaloed, ormar be-ibe sumarbaloed.
Degidbali, Egipto-yargi be-galagwensuli-gudigusad, be-gambanuchu-imakdigusad an obelogoed. Egipto-dulemar be bar-dakosulid, deginbali, Egipto-yargi be bar binsaosurbalid.’ ”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “Be we-dule-isdar-dakedga, an be-urmakoed, be we-dule-ima-dakedga an be-ukoed.

A-dulemar, isdar-be-dakmaloed, degi, bela be-ibe ibmar-sumaloed. Uka-swanga be-obemaloed, bela be-gambanuchu-imakdigusad wisgulegoed. Be-galagwensuli-guedginbi-binsadigusad, be-bingesulidgi-galagwensuli-nanadigusad bela wisgulegoed.
We-ibmar-deyob-guoedi, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladbo be gambanuchu-imakdigusad-ulale, deyob guoed. Degi, e-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklemalad-e-nug be odummodigusad-ulale, deyob guoed.
Ar be-ior-nanadigusadyob, be nanadimogad. A-ulale, be-ioryob sabsur-odurdaklegega an be-imakoed.
”Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged:

content.text: Geb e-goamargi, be dukin binasgar daas-daas imakdoed.

content: A-ulale, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “Ar be an-iessoggu, degi, be angi aibachasoggu, a-ulale, be-galagwensuli-gudigusad-ular, degi, be-gambanuchu-imakdigusad-ular, be sabsur-odurdaklegoed.”
Bab-Jehová anga sogded: “Dule-machi, ar be Aholaʼga, Aholibaʼga, ¿igar-nabogosursi? E-ibmar-isgana-imaksad ega be soge.

We-omegan sui-dikarba yolesmalad, degi, dulemar-ablis eosmalad. Na e-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklegedbo e-sui-dikarba yolesmalad. An-ega-mimmigan-baksa-gusadi, we-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklegedga soogi-ogumakar uksamalad, masyob ega uksamalad.
Deginbali, anse-goled-neg-oichosadgi angi nue-yolesmarbalid. Aginbali, an-obunnoged-iba-islidikid, iba-islidikidsulidyob daksamarbalid.
Na e-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakleged-e-nug-odummogega e-mimmigan-oburgwisad-ibagi, anse-goled-neggi uboddamalad. Degidba, an-neg-oichosmalad. We-ibmarmala, an-negyagi deyob imaksamalad.
Deginbali, dulemar-yar-baidginmalad-dikasulid-dagega imaksamarbalid. A-dulemar nonigua, we-omegan-warbogwad nue-obsamalad, ibya-siga magsamalad, degi, ormar-galagwensuli yosmalad.
A-sorbali, bato mese-guagwar-siid-asabin ganbuled-gargedgi sigismalad. A-mesegi ina-wawadikid, degi, olivo-gwallu-anga-nug-imaklesad sismalad.

”Dule-bukidar iba-onolenaidgi-oimakbukwad itoleged. We-dulemardi Sabeo-dorganad, nega-dulesulidganba-danimaladid. Amardi we-omeganga ibmar-sakwagi-nasikleged nasiksamalad. E-nonogi orgurgin-yeerdakleged ega sismarbalid.
”Geb we-ome na e-sui-dikarba-yoledii-sered-gudedgi an binsaded: ‘¿Emigindi, we-ome-gambanuchu-imakedbo amba galagwensuli gumarbalode?’
Ar ome-gambanuchubo-megedyobi, we-omebo megismalad. Weyobi, ome-gambanuchu-saed-Aholaʼye-nugadbo, degi, Aholibaʼye-nugadbo megismalad.

Degisoggu, negsichidgi-abirgunagwarsuli-nanaed-igar-maidba, degi, dule-gindaked-igar-maidba, dule-nuegan we-omeganga igar-nabogoed. Ar ade, we-omegan abirgunagwarsuli negsichidgi nanadimaladid, dule-gindakmaladbalid.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “We-omegangi-gwisgumalaga bela dulemar na atomala, dobee-itogega be imakmala, degi, e-ibe be ibmar-sumala.
Akwagi be we-omegan makmala. Es-suidgi be e-san goamakmala. E-machimala be oburgwemala, e-bunamala be oburgwemala. E-negmar be ogumakmala.
”We-galagwensuli-guedi, an we-yargi obelogoed. Deyobi, bela-omegan na wisi-gudimaloed. We-omegan-ibmar-isgana-imaksadba ibmar imakosurmalad.

We-omegan-galagwenmalad-warbogwadi, galagwensuli-nanasadba sabsur-odurdaklemaloed, degi, bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakleged-e-nug-odummosadba, sabsur-wilemaloed. Degidbali, wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad gue.”
